Thanks again for the discovery call yesterday. Based on what we covered, the next best step is a focused architecture walkthrough where our infra/serving lead (Aditya) can map Redwood’s routing, KV cache behavior, and private deployment options against your SRE constraints.

Suggested agenda (30–45 min):

- Corsair current infra & SLOs (10 min)
- Redwood runtime & integration touchpoints (15 min)
- Open questions + next steps (10 min)

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 11/11 10:00–10:45
- Thu 11/12 13:00–13:45
- Mon 11/15 08:30–09:15

I’m attaching a short integration outline and a sketch of where we expect to place the KV cache / prefix-routing layer so you can scan ahead. If none of these times work, send 2–3 slots that fit your team and we’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Irene
